project.name: CodeArena Common
project.description:
Domain vocabulary shared by the API server and the judge worker.
Deliberately tiny and dependency-free. It holds the identifiers and rules both deployables must agree on - what a language is called, what states a submission can be in, and which transitions are legal - and nothing else. Entities, repositories and services stay in the module that owns them, so this does not become a dumping ground that couples the two services together.
